description: Check a staff schedule against the staff you need. Send the scheduled shifts (date, start, end and how many people work it) and the required staff per time window (date, start, end, head count); overnight shifts and windows are fine. Get back, hour by hour, every gap hour (fewer people on duty than required at any minute of the hour, with how many short and for how many staff-minutes), every overstaffed hour (more people than required for the whole hour), the exact short periods to the minute, and totals: staff-hours required, scheduled, short and over, and the share of required staff-minutes that are covered. Up to 200 shifts and 200 windows over at most 8 days. Shifts carry a head count only: send no names. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/shift-coverage). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

need.description: Required staff windows (up to 200). Overlapping windows add up; time not inside any window needs 0 people.

end.description: End, HH:MM. An end at or before the start means the next day (22:00 to 06:00 is overnight); 00:00 is midnight.

staff.description: People required on duty during this window.

shifts.description: Scheduled shifts (up to 200). Split a shift around an unpaid break off the floor if the break should not count.
